rules.title: General prohibition on municipal rent control
rules.requirement: Cities and towns may not enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind. A municipality that accepts the chapter may adopt only voluntary rent control, which cannot regulate occupancy, services, evictions or condominium conversion, cannot apply to units owned by a person or entity owning fewer than ten rental units or to units with fair market rent above $400, and must compensate owners from general funds.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to all cities and towns in Massachusetts; bans local rent control on residential rentals.

exemption_tests.description: Cities or towns that accept the chapter may adopt voluntary rent control meeting conditions (voluntary compliance after six months, no regulation of occupancy/services/evictions, no application to owners of fewer than ten units or units with fair market rent over $400, municipal compensation to owners).

rules.exemptions_text: Any city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation meeting the conditions in (a)-(c).
rules.key_value: No local rent control; limited voluntary exception
